help.sea_level_altitude: Value in meters, must be changed according to device location. 122.0 meters is the average altitude in Milan, Italy
help.timezone: Standard tz timezone definition. More details at https://www.gnu.org/software/libc/manual/html_node/TZ-Variable.html
help.gas_sensor_type: Gas sensor type: 0 = MICS6814, 1 = MICS4514 (DFRobot SEN0377)
msp1_params: rheat_tamb_ohm: heater resistance at the Tamb reference point.
rheat_tamb_ref_c: temperature at which rheat_tamb_ohm was measured. Accepted range -40 to 85 C and below rheat_temp_max_c, otherwise 20 C is used.
ldo_index: NAU7802 LDO/AVDD (ADC reference) 0=2.4V 1=2.7V 2=3.0V 3=3.3V 4=3.6V 5=3.9V 6=4.2V 7=4.5V 8=EXTERNAL (LDO off, AVDD supplied externally, value from avdd_ext_mv).
avdd_ext_mv: externally supplied NAU7802 AVDD in mV, used as ADC reference ONLY when ldo_index=8 (EXTERNAL). Accepted range 2400-5500.
dac_vdd_mv: MCP4725 DAC supply/reference VDD in mV, ALWAYS taken from this value. Accepted range 2700-5500.
ramp_step_delay_ms: delay between heater soft-start ramp steps in ms. Accepted range 0-5000, above 5000 the default 500 is used. The ramp is 8 geometric steps, total ramp time = 8 x this value.
